newsitem.title: GERMANY: Telekom shares hit records in IBIS trade.
newsitem.headline: Telekom shares hit records in IBIS trade.

text.p: Shares in German telecommunications group Deutsche Telekom AG hit record highs in post-bourse trade on Tuesday, a move dealers attributed to technical factors.
Dealers said the share had breached an important technical barrier which helped it register further gains in electronic trade.

Shares in Telekom stood at 35 marks in afternoon trade, up 1.04 marks or some three percent, having earlier hit a high of 35.18 marks. The overall IBIS DAX index was up 25.36 points, or 0.74 percent, at 3,452.13 points.
